description: Open-source marketing automation for a 5-100 person team: segments, campaigns, landing pages, lead scoring and e-mail journeys sent through the operator's own mail infrastructure.
authMethod: Proxy gate only - Mautic keeps its own login (no OIDC/SAML in the free core)
packagingSource: vendored render set (platform/upstream/D02-01) over the pinned mautic/mautic:7.2.2-apache image; the application layer is built on the host as seamnex/mautic:7.2.2 and carries the first-boot installer

integration.authMethod: HTTP basic / OAuth2 against a Mautic API user

operationInventory.label: Read contacts
operationInventory.description: List and fetch contacts with their segment memberships and consent fields.

operationInventory.label: Create or update contact
operationInventory.description: Upsert a contact and add it to a segment.

operationInventory.label: Read segments
operationInventory.description: List segments and their member counts.

eventModes.label: Poll for new contacts and form submissions

notes: Campaign and segment mail is sent from a second container running the cron role; a web container alone renders the product but sends nothing. Deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) is an operator responsibility, not a platform one. The catalogue pins the upstream base image; the deployed tag is the vendored wrapper built from it.
